title: Preventing Something: Para Que No and No Sea Que
goal: Say what you want to avoid with para que no, a fin de que no and para no + infinitive, and warn with no sea que.

items: I can say what I want to avoid with para que no, a fin de que no and para no + infinitive.
I can warn about a possible problem with no sea que + subjunctive.
I can use the new words for caution and precautions.
